name: suppressed-baseline-errors

result.what: MVS_PRO_DIR / MVS_PRO_URL constants defined in wpmediaverse-pro.php but PHPStan analysis scope only sees includes/, never the bootstrap that defines them. Stub or shim would clear all 45.
result.fix_cost: trivial — add a phpstan-stubs file declaring the two constants

result.what: WP_CLI:: static-method calls in CLI importer code paths and AbstractBatchImporter base. PHPStan WordPress stubs don't ship the WP_CLI class.
result.fix_cost: trivial — add szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress wp-cli stubs to phpstan.neon

result.what: esc_html()/esc_attr() called on int/float values from query results — PHPStan flags the missing string cast. WP itself does the coercion at runtime, so no functional bug.
result.fix_cost: small — cast each int to (string) before esc_*. Worth doing in 1.2.1; defensible to suppress now.

result.what: PHPStan-inferred-true ternary/empty conditions — typically defensive guards that the type system can prove unreachable but humans want kept for runtime safety.
result.fix_cost: case-by-case — sometimes the type is wrong (real bug), sometimes the guard is genuinely defensive (suppress).

result.what: WPINC constant referenced from base classes (AbstractBatchImporter, AbstractMigrationAdmin). Not stubbed in this phpstan setup.
result.fix_cost: trivial — already stubbed in szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress; add it

result.what: Defensive `is_wp_error()` checks on methods whose typed signature doesn't include WP_Error. WhisperProvider (Integrations\Whisper\CaptionProvider) is the main one — its method returns array but real-world it can also return WP_Error. The typed signature is wrong, not the check.
result.fix_cost: small — widen return type to WP_Error|array on the provider

result.what: get_posts() called with meta_key/meta_value flat shape; PHPStan's WP stubs prefer the meta_query nested shape. Functional but stricter-than-WP signature in the stubs.
result.fix_cost: small — migrate to meta_query nested shape on the 4 BuddyBoss/MediaPress importer + migration-admin queries

result.what: rtMedia row objects accessed via ->media_author etc. — rtMedia's stdClass doesn't have a typed schema and PHPStan can't prove the property exists.
result.fix_cost: small — type-cast or PHPDoc-annotate the rtMedia row shapes

result.what: Two methods (Privacy/PrivacyUIService, Video/TranscodeService::get_transcode_timeout) not called from anywhere PHPStan can see. May be filter callbacks invoked dynamically.
result.fix_cost: verify each — delete if truly dead, suppress if dynamic-dispatch

result.what: paginate_links() called with `total: float` instead of int (QuotaPage.php).
AnalyticsService::prune_events action callback returns int (DELETE row count) but action callbacks should return void.
TranscriptionService line treats Whisper provider's WP_Error return as if it lived in WPMediaVersePro\Integrations\Whisper\WP_Error namespace. Use clause not aliased.
result.fix_cost: trivial — add `use WP_Error;` import at top of CaptionProvider.php

result.what: as_has_scheduled_action() — Action Scheduler integration. Functions not in core stubs.
result.fix_cost: trivial — stub the 4 AS functions in phpstan.neon

result.what: Method docblock has invalid type (QuotaService::enforce_quota's $args parameter).
StreakService uses ?-> on a non-nullable type. Either the type is over-narrowed or the nullsafe is over-defensive.
result.fix_cost: trivial — drop ? or widen the type

result.what: TranscodeService references $file_path in a path where it isn't always defined — possible real bug. Worth verifying.
result.fix_cost: small — confirm the bug, add the missing initialization OR convert to a local

notes: Sub-check 2.5.13. Down 17 errors from 158 (2026-05-01 baseline) to 141 (2026-05-03), driven entirely by the messaging cleanup deletion of 5 PHP files in includes/Messaging/. Of the 141 ignored errors, ~75 (53%) are pure noise from missing stubs (Pro constants, WP_CLI class, WPINC, Action Scheduler) — clearable with one phpstan.neon edit. Functionally meaningful candidates: 5 is_wp_error_always_false (Whisper return-type widening), 1 undefined_variable (TranscodeService — should re-check), 19 numeric_to_esc_string_coercion (low-risk, low-effort cleanup target for 1.2.1).
